_comment: Game requirement flags -> the quest record whose completion sets them.
The game gates content on named flags (`requirements.repaired_haydens_farm
= true` on six of the eight ranch animals), and `fiddle/requirements.toml`
states what each flag means — almost always `seen_cutscene = "..."`, and a
cutscene belongs to a quest stage. That chain is stated, but the last hop
(game quest id -> our record id) needs a human because the game's ids and
titles disagree with each other: `repair_haydens_barn` is titled 'Upgrade
Hayden's Barn', which is why our record is `upgrade_haydens_barn`.
A flag not listed here is held back into a data gap by the builders, never
guessed at. Each entry says why the mapping is right and where it is

repaired_haydens_farm.reason: requirements.toml [repaired_haydens_farm] states seen_cutscene = 'repair_haydens_barn_pt_2', a stage of the game quest repair_haydens_barn — which ships as upgrade_haydens_barn after its own stated title, 'Upgrade Hayden's Barn'.
